items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: The interviewee addresses the interviewer as 'Monk' (Monk Rowe) and asks about his nickname. The interviewee discusses Thelonious Monk only in the context of the interviewer's name, stating 'Actually it was because of a big, long, blue coat...'. ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe and I’m here at the Hotel Utica with vibist Peter Appleyard. Welcome to Utica.
Thanks, Monk. Before we go any further, how did you get the name Monk?
Aha! You’ve turned the tables on me. Actually it was because of a big, long, blue coat I used to wear, with a hood on it.
